content_zh:
每天都有骑士来找他切磋，邢烨也顺势学习这个世界的剑术，技多不压身。游戏的恶意很深，多掌握一些技能总有一天会用上。
邢烨的个子不矮，足有180+，克莱尔的身体将他的身高稍稍减少了五厘米，但也算是高的了。可公爵府的骑士大都身材魁梧，原本是黄种人的邢烨在骑士团中就略显瘦弱。
他与女仆站在一起时看不出什么异样，但在骑士团中，在一群熊的对比之下，就有些违和了。
加西亚公爵站在窗前看站在院子中的邢烨，微微皱眉。
“劳伦斯是一名优秀的骑士，”老管家看出公爵大人的视线焦点，适时夸赞道，“他现在已经是骑士团的中心了，恭喜公爵大人又获得一名勇士。”
加西亚却并不觉得开心，摇摇头道：“是太优秀了些。”
“明日就是女王的生日了，准备得怎么样了？”加西亚转移话题。
“公爵大人请放心，礼物已经重新包装，骑士团也做了新衣服，保证我们在贵族中是最体面的。”老管家说道。
“那就好。”加西亚点点头，又回头看了眼邢烨，“明天叫劳伦斯也一起去吧，与沃克骑士一起作为我的贴身护卫。”
“遵命。”
第二天一早，邢烨换上女仆送来的新骑士装，外套是立领长衣，白色金边，显得身材修长，足下一双黑色的长靴还带点内增高，让邢烨看起来又高挑了些。
黑金色的腰带将他的腰勾勒得极为纤细，邢烨系好扣子活动了一下，发现这看似贴身束缚的衣服活动起来竟然还挺方便的。
镜子：去皇宫就是自投罗网，你该拒绝的。
“我若是操纵者，一定会兵分两路，一人在皇宫，另外一人趁着加西亚公爵府没有几个能打的骑士硬闯进来搜身。只要能够搜出我，并在加西亚公爵府搜出镜子，冒犯贵族的事情就可以用罪名遮掩过去。留在府邸没有加西亚公爵做主，才是真的完蛋。”邢烨耐心地向镜子解释道。
镜子：可皇宫是对方的主场。
“嗯，”邢烨毫不在意地说道。“所以当主人的才更不能犯错，在皇宫内，重点就不是两名操纵者，而是女王和加西亚公爵。”
他对镜子说道：“魔镜魔镜，我将你私藏在身上，女王会用超自然手段发现你的存在吗？”
系统附体的镜子：“不会的，现在的她内心已经被黑暗占据，容不下一丝光明，是无法感受到我的存在的。”
确认女王只能用物理手段搜身找到镜子后，邢烨放心地将镜子藏在身上，整理下衣领，走出房门。
等候在门外的女仆看到邢烨后微微脸红一下，低下头将手绢递给邢烨，这是一名骑士的必备品。

十分有礼貌地谢过女仆，邢烨将手绢叠好放在胸前口袋中，走到府外与大部队会合。
骑士团的人见到邢烨眼睛纷纷一亮，与他关系较好的沃克骑士队长更是跑过来说道：“这件衣服真是太适合你了，你与我们简直就是天鹅与丑小鸭。”
邢烨淡淡道：“整齐划一的衣服注重的不是个人，而是团体面貌，我们是一个整体。”
“正是如此。”加西亚公爵鼓掌道，“大家都非常英俊，随我一起去皇宫，让其他人看看我们加西亚公爵府的气势。”
“愿为您效劳！”二十名白衣骑士齐声道。
不得不说财富堆出来的队伍真的很有排场，二十名骑士骑着一样高大的白马，吸引了无数人的目光。
抵达皇宫后，女王将加西亚与其他贵族一同请到茶话室，骑士们在旁边的房间喝茶等待自己的主人。
不同贵族的骑士团也存在着竞争关系，比衣服比长相有时还会比剑术，沃克等骑士与其他骑士团的人唇枪舌战，邢烨毫不在意，在一旁安静喝茶。
果然过了一会儿，女王的侍卫队就进入这个房间。几天前被沃克骑士打败的侍卫长穿得更加庄重，还带了上百个侍卫来，将加西亚公爵的骑士团围住。
侍卫长说：“每个进城的人都接受了检查，只有加西亚公爵的队伍因为特殊原因没有搜身，请诸位骑士移步，接受我们的检查。”
这一次他拿出了有女王签名的文件，又将人带到另外一间房，给了骑士们应有的体面，这次大家再没拒绝的权利，就算认出侍卫长是上次沃克的手下败将也不能反抗。

content_en:
Knights came to him every day to learn from each other, and Xing Ye also took advantage of the situation to learn the swordsmanship of this world. There are many skills that are not overwhelming. The game is very malicious, and if you master a few more skills you will come in handy one day.
Xing Ye is not short, he is over 180cm tall. Claire's body slightly reduces his height by five centimeters, but he is still considered tall. However, most of the knights in the Duke's Palace are tall and tall, and Xing Ye, who was originally a yellow race, is a bit thin among the knights.
When he stood with the maid, he couldn't see anything strange, but among the knights, in contrast to a group of bears, it seemed a little out of place.
Duke Garcia stood in front of the window and looked at Xing Ye standing in the yard, frowning slightly.
"Lawrence is an excellent knight," the old butler saw the focus of the Duke's gaze and praised him at the right time. "He is now the center of the Knights. Congratulations to the Duke for gaining another warrior."
Garcia, however, did not feel happy. He shook his head and said, "It's too good."
"Tomorrow is the Queen's birthday, how are you preparing?" Garcia changed the subject.
"Don't worry, Duke, the gifts have been repackaged, and the knights have also made new clothes to ensure that we are the most respectable among the nobles." The old butler said.
"That's good." Garcia nodded and looked back at Xing Ye, "Let's ask Lawrence to go with us tomorrow and serve as my personal bodyguard with Knight Walker."
"As commanded."
Early the next morning, Xing Ye put on the new knight uniform sent by the maid. The coat was a long coat with a stand-up collar and white gold rim, which made him look slender. He also wore a pair of black boots with a slight increase in height, making Xing Ye look taller.
The black and gold belt outlined his waist very slenderly. Xing Ye fastened the buttons and moved around, and found that this seemingly tight-fitting and restrictive clothes was actually quite convenient to move.
Mirror: Going to the palace is throwing yourself into a trap. You should refuse.
"If I were the manipulator, I would have divided my forces into two groups. One would be in the palace, and the other would break in and search the Duke of Garcia's palace while there were few knights who could fight. As long as I can be found and the mirror is found in the Duke of Garcia's palace, the offense against the nobles can be covered up with charges. If I stay in the mansion without Duke Garcia to make the decision, I will really be finished." Xing Ye patiently explained to the mirror.
Mirror: But the palace is the opponent’s home court.
"Yeah," Xing Ye said nonchalantly. "So the master cannot make mistakes. In the palace, the focus is not on the two manipulators, but on the Queen and Duke Garcia."
He said to the mirror: "Mirror, Mirror, I hide you secretly on my body, will the Queen use supernatural means to discover your existence?"
The mirror possessed by the system: "No, her heart is now occupied by darkness and cannot tolerate a trace of light. She cannot feel my existence."
After confirming that the Queen could only use physical means to search her body to find the mirror, Xing Ye safely hid the mirror on his body, straightened his collar, and walked out of the room.
The maid waiting outside the door blushed slightly when she saw Xing Ye, lowered her head and handed the handkerchief to Xing Ye, which was a must-have for a knight.
Xing Ye thanked the maid very politely, folded the handkerchief and put it in his breast pocket, and walked outside the house to meet the large army.
Everyone in the Knights' eyes lit up when they saw Xing Ye. Captain Walker Knight, who had a good relationship with him, even ran over and said, "This dress suits you so well. You and we are just like the swan and the ugly duckling."
Xing Ye said calmly: "Neat and uniform clothes focus not on the individual, but on the appearance of the group. We are a whole."
"That's right." Duke Garcia applauded. "Everyone is very handsome. Come with me to the palace and let others see the momentum of our Duke Garcia's palace."
"I am willing to serve you!" Twenty knights in white said in unison.
I have to say that the procession formed by the wealth was really grand. Twenty knights rode the same tall white horses.Attracted the attention of countless people.
After arriving at the palace, the queen invited Garcia and other nobles to the tea room. The knights drank tea in the next room and waited for their master.
The knights of different nobles also had competitive relationships. They competed on clothes and looks and sometimes on swordsmanship. Walker and other knights were quarreling with members of other knights. Xing Ye didn't care and drank tea quietly.
Sure enough, after a while, the Queen's guards entered the room. The captain of the guard who was defeated by Knight Walker a few days ago dressed more solemnly and brought hundreds of guards to surround Duke Garcia's knights.
The captain of the guard said: "Everyone entering the city has been inspected. Only Duke Garcia's team was not searched due to special reasons. Please move forward and accept our inspection."
This time he took out the document signed by the Queen and took the people to another room, giving the knights the dignity they deserve. This time no one had the right to refuse. Even if they recognized that the captain of the guard was the defeated general of Walker's men last time, they could not resist.
